title: Saffron Air SF-954 cancelled - two-week notice: refund owed, no compensation

dispute.narrative: My Saffron Air flight SF-954 GOI-HYD was cancelled. I have not received what I am owed.

documents.title: E-ticket / itinerary receipt
documents.text:
E-TICKET / ITINERARY RECEIPT
Passenger: Arjun Mehta
Booking reference (PNR): 2AG2ED
Flight: SF-954 GOI-HYD departing 01-Sep-2026 21:40 IST
Base fare INR 7,600.00 | Fuel charge INR 1,150.00 | Taxes and fees INR 480.00
Total paid INR 9,230.00 by credit card

documents.title: Cancellation SMS
documents.text: Dear Arjun, Saffron Air regrets that flight SF-954 GOI-HYD scheduled 01-Sep-2026 21:40 IST is cancelled. Sent 12-Aug-2026 01:40 IST.

agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking 2AG2ED on SF-954; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Saffron Air: I request INR 9,230.00 for the cancellation of SF-954 (PNR 2AG2ED) on 01 Sep 2026.
review_notes: Citations to be checked against regulation text.
citations: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV - compensation in addition to refund when a cancellation is notified less than 24 hours before departure
CAR Section 3 Series M Part II - refunds within 7 days for credit card purchases
